versions.changelog:
Initial release of the worldcup26-api skill:

- Provides real-time football scores, schedules, and standings for 34+ major competitions, including the 2026 World Cup.
- Simple API endpoints for live scores, match schedules, and group standings.
- Multiple pricing plans: free tier available, with higher allowances for paid plans.
- Suitable for integration in AI agents, media, and data analysis applications.
- Chinese and English documentation with usage examples and support contact.
